in_sanskrit.name: दुराय
in_sanskrit.meaning: difficult to overcome, hard to overcome
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is difficult to overcome or hard to overcome.

in_hindi.name: दुराय
in_hindi.meaning: संतुष्ट न होने वाला, विघ्न दहन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is not satisfied, the one who causes obstacles to be burnt.

in_tamil.name: துரை
in_tamil.meaning: தோர், கடல், கடவுள், உடன் கொடுத்துல் இருக்கும்
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is present, the one who is the lord of the sea, the one who is the god present in our midst.

in_telugu.name: దురై
in_telugu.long_meaning: The lord, the god, the god of gods.

in_marathi.name: Durai
in_marathi.long_meaning: Durai हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Tamil word ‘durai’, meaning ‘fortress’ or ‘strong’. This name is associated with strength, power, and protection.
